notes.title: ［TIGS2025］ Alpha v3.55f5 patch notes
notes.notes:
Feature Updates:


 The starting battery count is now reduced to two ✌️
 Added new map images
 Opened towers are now displayed on the map
 Dropping items is now mapped to Controller  / Keyboard [Q]
 Added a hidden side quest related to a colleague
 Added an Easter egg
 Tweaked and refined the toad-related level
 Improved guidance in certain levels
 Treasure chests now contain items
 Added an achievement counter UI below the minimap


Bug Fixes:


 Fixed an issue where footstep effects were not displaying correctly
 Various debugging and fixes

notes.title: Alpha v 3.54f4 patch note
notes.notes:
Features:
- Added Japanese language support.
- Introduced various underwater ecosystems and effects.
- The captain can now give you multiple batteries at once.
- Removed sprinting and increased movement speed.
- Optimized the experience of dragging and placing monument fragments.
- The green orbs on the giant tree can now be consumed infinitely.
- Looking up on land will no longer cause the camera to enter the water.
- Added various environmental sounds and improved BGM transition experience.
- Removed ocean currents.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where quickly placing items had no effect.
- Fixed a bug where skipping quickly would increase the tower count by two.
- Fixed an issue where the first battery would loop indefinitely.
- Fixed an issue where the strong wind near the Giant Toad King’s tower would get stuck.
- Multiple visual errors fixed.
- Various UI bug fixes and improved user experience.
- Fixed multiple animation playback issues.
- Fixed certain collision box shapes that caused stuck issues.
- Fixed multiple interaction issues and bugs with game mechanics.

notes.title: Alpha Test Now Release!
notes.notes:
Apologies for the wait! After a week of sleepless effort by our team,  is now ready for your exploration. This version is an enhanced edition from the G-Eight Game Show exhibition, featuring not just bug fixes and UI optimizations, but also new achievements and a complete ending! Investigators who have already played can still discover something new.

Demo highlights:
16 Towers
8 Treasure Chests
7 Achievements

Thank you so much for your support. We look forward to seeing all of you Investigators on our Discord server!
